task: figure out the $388 car rental payment Tova sent you: what it was for and whether the amount is right.
transcript: Opened the app: a Home screen saying 'What can I help with?' with a text box, three example prompts and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.
Typed 'Tova sent me $388 for a car rental. What was it for and is the amount right?' and pressed enter; the button changed to 'Sending'.
Waited 30 seconds: the screen titled the request 'Check Tova's $388 car rental payment', said 'Your family admin helper is on it' with Change and Details links, and showed 'Working on it'.
Waited 30 more seconds: got the answer. It is her half of the Hertz rental for the Vermont trip and it is 20 cents short: total $776.40, half $388.20, she sent $388.00.

The answer listed pickup at Burlington Airport Thu Nov 5, return Sat Nov 7, cost $612.00 base + $112.40 taxes and fees + $52.00 fuel service on my Visa ending 4411, and her Venmo on Mon Nov 9 with the note 'car rental vermont, half'. It said she probably rounded and it is not worth chasing.
Viewed the screenshot and scrolled up to re-read the whole answer; the parts add up (612 + 112.40 + 52 = 776.40, half = 388.20).
stumbles: The line 'Your family admin helper is on it' with 'Change' and 'Details' links was a little puzzling (who is the helper, what would Change do?), but I could ignore it.
The answer never showed me the actual Hertz receipt or Venmo email, so I took its figures on trust; the arithmetic checks out, though.
The bullet list was slightly misformatted: the last line 'She probably just rounded' ran into the Venmo bullet.
verdict: One question and about a minute of waiting gave me exactly what I wanted: what the $388 was for, the full breakdown, and that she was 20 cents short. It felt just like asking ChatGPT, with nothing sent anywhere.
